description: Deterministic registry of explicitly documented pricing governance exceptions. This registry is not a waiver system and does not suppress audit findings in v1.
rules: Every exception references one deterministic audit check_id and one explicit target_file.
Exceptions are allowlist records, not pattern ignores.
Expired exceptions remain visible until resolved.
Brain-only concepts may never be waived into production.
Exception entries do not auto-suppress FAIL severity unless explicitly approved in a future audit-engine integration.
Historical status does not automatically waive artifact governance.
Publication status never counts as Human Gate approval.
future_integration_notes: A future audit-engine integration may load this registry to annotate known findings.
A future audit-engine integration may downgrade known warnings after explicit policy approval.
A future audit-engine integration may fail expired exceptions.
No audit suppression, CI integration, or production schema behavior is implemented by this registry file.
